description: Repeat the targets as a live radial, grid or mirror repeat (Object > Repeat > Radial, Grid, Mirror; Illustrator 2023 or later), optionally setting its options: instances, radius and reverseOverlap for radial; horizontalSpacing, verticalSpacing, gridType, flipRows and flipColumns for grid; axisAngle for mirror

axisAngle.description: Mirror: angle of the mirror axis in degrees, anticlockwise from horizontal

flipColumns.description: Grid: Flip Column, mirroring alternate columns

flipRows.description: Grid: Flip Row, mirroring alternate rows

horizontalSpacing.description: Grid: horizontal spacing between tiles in points (negative overlaps)

reverseOverlap.description: Radial: reverse the overlap of the instances

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

verticalSpacing.description: Grid: vertical spacing between tiles in points (negative overlaps)

name: make_repeat
title: Make Repeat
